digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and command routing
propositions: Advanced command grammars across bridge, reconciler, audit, LLM, workflow, identity, and gate families currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and must be extracted into reusable S2a side-effect-free factories.

Parser factories must remain lean—importing no optional runtimes (Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing)—while supporting all current command families and nested subcommand selection.
Parse-failure handling must migrate from `except SystemExit` to `except ParseError`, preserving identical process exit code (2) and stderr/usage bytes with no traceback leakage.

Bespoke parser presentation (`usage=`, `RawDescriptionHelpFormatter`, `add_help=False`) for six command families must be preserved by extending the S2a factory with optional keyword passthroughs that default to current behavior.
Every advanced route must have a deterministic, valid factory reference and be ready for S2d generation-time invocation without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes.
